summary: AMETEK filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for an offering of two series of unsecured senior notes (amounts, coupons and maturities left blank), ranking pari passu with existing senior unsecured debt, with BofA Securities, J.P. Morgan, Wells Fargo Securities and BNP Paribas as joint book-running managers. Proceeds, together with concurrent securities offerings, will repay borrowings under financing agreements and commercial paper used for the already-closed ~$5 billion cash acquisition of Indicor Instrumentation, agreed May 5, 2026 and closed August 26, 2026. Notes carry a 101% change-of-control repurchase and tax-redemption call; watch pricing and leverage.
